rules.message: File exceeds 300 LOC. Split by responsibility (rule: file-size).

The engine is provider- and UI-agnostic: it must not import UI or app code. Dependencies flow apps → ui → engine only (rule: engine-isolation). Browser globals are already rejected by the engine's tsconfig (no DOM/chrome libs). See CLAUDE.md.

The fleet core is provider- and UI-agnostic: it must not import UI or app code. Dependencies flow apps → fleet/ui → engine only (rule: fleet-isolation). Browser globals are already rejected by the fleet tsconfig (no DOM/chrome libs). See CONTROL-ROOM-CONSTITUTION.md.

The CDN/manifest update channel is extension-only (BL-015). github.com CSP forbids remote code, so the bookmarklet stays self-contained (BL-013) and must never import the channel modules (rule: channel-isolation). See MVP.md §5.2.
github.com CSP forbids injecting HTML strings. Build the CSP-safe way: createElement + textContent (use @triage/ui el()) (rule: csp-safe-dom). See CLAUDE.md hard constraints.
CSP forbids inline style attributes. Set styles via CSSOM: element.style.<prop> = ... (rule: csp-safe-dom).
CSP forbids inline event-handler attributes. Use addEventListener instead (rule: csp-safe-dom).
